title: Row 16 (ii-b) — position-angle-restoring parity transfer through the released P4' chirality pipeline, plus the corrected error bar on the N=20,000 row 16(ii) injection slope
preregistration: pipelines/p4prime_chirality_test/row16_pa_parity_transfer/PREREGISTRATION_2026-09-19.md (git 12248d70, committed before any statistic was computed)

inputs.name: row 16(ii) N=20,000 galaxy sample (RA/Dec/class_eq/hpix/cutout URL), drawn from bamfai/galaxy-chirality-catalog

Legacy Survey DR9 jpeg cutouts, 150 px, layer ls-dr9, for those galaxies (19,800 of 20,000 cached on disk from the 2026-09-04 row 16(ii) run; the 200 missing are the 2026-09-04 fetch failures and are simply absent, not replaced)
committed row 16(ii) forward-pass pairs, reused unchanged for statistic S4 (no new inference)
chirality classifier checkpoint (ViT-S/16 encoder + 3-class head), identical revision pin to row 16(ii)

apis.name: huggingface_hub.hf_hub_download (model checkpoint only; the cutouts are read from the local cache, no network needed to reproduce the inference stage)

environment.python: python3.14 + torch 2.13.0 + timm + PIL + pandas + numpy + huggingface_hub + matplotlib
environment.hardware: local Apple Silicon MPS (Metal), macOS arm64 — no GPU rental needed

reproduction.recommended_venue: local MPS/CUDA; nothing here needs a rented GPU
reproduction.notes: run_pa_transfer_inference.py checkpoints pa_transfer_probs.npz every 2,000 galaxies and resumes when the cached-index list matches. The analysis stages need no GPU. Total new inference is N x 8 angles x 2 mirror-states = 316,800 forward passes; every f/seed grid point of S3 and S4 is evaluated in closed form from those stored probabilities, with no re-inference.
